title.original: Demystifying the Lifecycle of Failures in Platform-Orchestrated Agentic Workflows
title.zh: 揭示平台编排的代理工作流程中故障的生命周期
title.en: Demystifying the Lifecycle of Failures in Platform-Orchestrated Agentic Workflows

inclusion_reason.zh: AgentFail 的失效生命周期 schema 与真实平台案例可复用于运行时遥测设计、根因诊断和修复策略评测。
inclusion_reason.en: AgentFail's failure-lifecycle schema and real platform incidents are reusable for runtime telemetry design, root-cause diagnosis, and repair evaluation.

abstract.zh: 该研究从失效生命周期分析低代码平台编排的 Agent 工作流，并发布 AgentFail：来自两个代表性平台的真实故障案例集。论文关联故障表现、根因、所在节点、修复策略和修复难度，为运行时诊断与工作流设计提供经验依据。
abstract.en: This study analyzes failures across the lifecycle of low-code, platform-orchestrated agent workflows and releases AgentFail, a corpus of real incidents from two representative platforms. It links manifestations, root causes, workflow nodes, repair strategies, and repair difficulty.

problem.zh: 自然语言交互、工具调用和动态控制会让故障跨异构节点传播，传统软件的局部错误定位方法难以解释 Agent 工作流中的表现与根因。
problem.en: Natural-language interaction, tool use, and dynamic control let failures propagate across heterogeneous nodes, making traditional local fault attribution ineffective for agent workflows.

approach.zh: 研究者收集并编码 307 个平台故障案例，从表现、根因和修复三个阶段建立分类，并比较不同根因与节点的修复难度。
approach.en: The researchers collect and code 307 platform failures into manifestation, root-cause, and repair stages, then compare repair difficulty across causes and workflow nodes.

system_design.zh: AgentFail 的生命周期 schema 可映射到运行时事件：节点输入/输出记录表现，依赖与调用轨迹支持根因归因，补丁与重配置记录修复方式，便于构建诊断工具。
system_design.en: AgentFail's lifecycle schema maps naturally to runtime telemetry: node I/O captures symptoms, dependency and call traces support attribution, and patches or reconfiguration encode repair actions for diagnostic tooling.

key_results.zh: 案例分析揭示了平台 Agent 工作流的关键传播机制、根因分布与修复难点，并形成针对可靠修复和流程设计的可操作建议。
key_results.en: The case analysis identifies important propagation mechanisms, root-cause patterns, and repair bottlenecks and yields actionable guidance for workflow design and reliable repair.

limitations.zh: 案例仅来自两个平台并受公开报告完整性影响，难以估计未报告故障和真实发生率；分类结论对自建代码框架的可迁移性仍需验证。
limitations.en: Cases come from two platforms and depend on report completeness, so silent failures and true prevalence are unknown; transfer to code-first, self-hosted frameworks remains to be validated.

notes.zh: 案例数、平台数和故障生命周期分析来自官方摘要；平台名称、分类频次、节点分布和修复难度统计待全文审计。
notes.en: Case count, platform count, and failure-lifecycle analysis come from the official abstract; platform names, category frequencies, node distribution, and repair statistics await full-text audit.
